comments.author: mattjj
comments.body:
I think we dropped support for Python 3.10 after jax==0.6.2, so this is an unsupported configuration (see [deprecation](http://localhost:8000/deprecation.html)).

@hawkinsp WDYT of #39001, even though this is unsupported? It's hard for me to guess the complexity cost here.

comments.author: hawkinsp
comments.body: I think we shouldn't do this. The whole point of having a deprecation policy is that we do not need or accept code to support Python versions older than our cutoff (Python 3.11 at present).
